title.en: Validate a relief kitchen and its production run

goal.en: A Kitchen document describes stations, capacity and rule packs; a ProductionRun records recipes, assignments, critical control points and an outcome (here 710 meals produced, 650 served, one CCP failure). Both examples are illustrative; no real kitchen is described. Validate and hash them.

note.en: Validate the example Kitchen (disaster type, 350 meals per hour, five stations). The reference hub's validate checks the document against the schema file's root; this schema keeps its kinds under $defs, so today this call reports ok for any document, and `cookwala validate` (the CLI line) is the real check.
Validate the example ProductionRun (lentil soup and rice with vermicelli for a relief program, halal, peanuts blocked).
Hash the run: the hash is what a Humanitarian Distribution or an audit refers to.

outcome.en: You know the documents a kitchen keeps and how a run links to Core executions and to a Distribution. Fleet dispatch stays with Open-RMF or a vendor. Next: 096 shows the agent rule on recipe text.
